meta.parties: Kandiah Et. Al. v. Thavar Et. Al

rules.statement: In an action against a person appointed under the provisions of section 642, the plaintiff can levy execution against other property of the estate if the amount of the decree is not realized by the sale of the mortgaged property.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am in complete agreement with the reasons given, by Schneider J. for his opinion that in an action against a person appointed under the provisions of section 642 the plaintiff can levy execution against other property of the estate if the amount of the decree is not realized by the sale of the mortgaged property."
